notes.title: We celebrate the Book of Travels EA with a Launch Bundle – save up to 70%!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hello![/b][/h2]

Might And Delight are thrilled about finally having launched [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1152340/Book_of_Travels/]Book of Travels[/url] into Early Access! This is [b]the start of a new world that we'll be building together with players[/b], and by way of a launch trailer, artist Lotta gives an overview of the phases of development that will come next in this video. We hope you like what you see!

[previewyoutube=D6UFUUvWzUA;full][/previewyoutube]

Take advantage of the Early Access Launch Sale and get Book of Travels for 10% off! 
(Sale ends Monday, October 18th, 10 am PT.) 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1152340/Book_of_Travels/

[h2]Celebrate with a beautiful bundle![/h2]

To celebrate the launch of our TMORPG Book of Travels we've put [b]a beautifully packaged bundle of Might and Delight treats[/b]. We hope you agree that this array of goods comes at a really appealing price and will give you any extra incentive you need to get on board and support Book of Travels in its fledgling week.

[b]Save up to 70% [/b](the discount may differ depending on what games and DLCs you already own)!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/23065/Book_of_Travels_EA_Launch_Bundle__10_Games__16_DLCs/

The [b]Book of Travels Early Access Launch Bundle[/b] and Sale ends after this weekend, so don’t snooze!
 
[i]Thanks for keeping your eyes on our games and our studio here on Steam![/i] If you've missed out on any or all of our journey to this audacious moment, please take a little peek at our blogs and videos on our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1152340]news page[/url] – [b]we'd love to have you with us on this great adventure!
[/b]
[b]Best Wishes,

Helen & The Dev Team[/b]

notes.title: Pan-Pan pre-order
notes.content:
Countdown to full release is now on.
For the price of the base game, you get the following:

- Pan-Pan Base game
- Pan-Pan Soundtrack
- Explorer's Guide to Pan-Pan

This runs from now August 15 to August 24.
